INFRA_PREEXECUTION.definition: job never obtains usable execution habitat; runner_id=0 and/or zero executed steps
INFRA_PREEXECUTION.non_compensation_rule: successful execution in another repo does not clear the blocked repo-local gate

QUEUE_DOMINATED.definition: runner executes normally but queue/admission delay exceeds useful execution time for a lightweight pulse
routing: job consolidation where evidence boundaries allow

BUILD_DOMINATED.definition: useful execution is dominated by dependency install/build rather than queue

EXECUTION_DOMINATED.definition: intrinsic compute dominates elapsed work after queue/build costs are bounded
EXECUTION_DOMINATED.semantic_repair_allowed: only when algorithm/runtime semantics justify it

measured_baseline.note: lightweight but queue does not dominate

derived_sample_signal.interpretation: two fresh exact-SHA control jobs independently reinforce the prior queue-dominance signal, but job-runtime rows are retained separately from the earlier expedition execute-time table rather than silently pooled

infra_preexecution_control.historical_cross_repo_signal: zero-step history also exists outside cryoplant; classify as historical account/repo admission evidence until fresh current telemetry proves a shared live condition
infra_preexecution_control.non_compensation_observation: pipeline-automation-hub runs 34774328258 and 34774493436 both obtained real runners and executed; they prove ordinary queue pressure on that repo only and do not clear cryoplant#923

sentinel_rules: runner_id=0 or steps=0 before payload => INFRA_PREEXECUTION; do not patch application/debugger semantics
runner assigned and queue_seconds > execute_seconds on bounded lightweight task => QUEUE_DOMINATED
do not merge queue time, designed human wait, dependency build time and zero-step admission into one latency feature
self-hosted capacity is justified only by measured avoided queue/build cost and utilization, not by one slow run
solved LLDB/DAP/MCP/debugpy/js-debug surfaces remain CONTROL unless runtime regression is observed

candidate_interventions.name: fast lane for short queue-sensitive control pulses
dependency/build cache and build-once artifact reuse

h4_objective: expected pressure reduction * evidence confidence * reuse multiplier / (crew time + queue time + execution time + coordination drag)
bt_rule: pair only comparable interventions on the same workload class, source contract and semantic outcome; order must be counterbalanced or observed
control_exit: at least one exact-source before/after intervention reduces measured pressure with unchanged semantic output and survives a distinct-source repeat
